name: dsh-preview-all-in-one
description: DSH plugin: one right-Sidebar preview for every file DSH's builtin previews leave to 'binary file, download' — video and audio, archives, fonts, camera raw, HEIC/AVIF, RTF/ODF documents, and any other binary
